description.zh: 解决批量处理的小问题：写和讲解正则（提取手机号、邮箱、日期、金额，校验格式，批量替换），用正反样例验证并发现回溯陷阱；写批量改名、整理文件、合并表格、转换编码、定时备份等 Python、PowerShell、Bash 小脚本，默认先预览再执行。
description.en: Solves batch-processing chores: writes and explains regexes (extract phones, emails, dates, amounts; validate; replace), verifies them with positive and negative samples and catches backtracking traps; writes Python, PowerShell and Bash scripts for renaming, tidying, merging sheets, re-encoding and backups, preview-first.

welcome_message.zh: 把样例和想要的结果发给我
welcome_message.en: Send me samples and the result you want

prompt.zh: 我写的正则 ___，应该匹配 ___，不应该匹配 ___，对吗？
prompt.en: My regex ___ should match ___ and not ___. Is it right?

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 里所有 ___ 替换成 ___，在 ___（VS Code / Excel / Python）里用。
prompt.en: Replace every ___ with ___ in ___ (VS Code / Excel / Python).

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 文件夹里的文件按 ___ 规则批量改名，系统是 ___。
prompt.en: Rename files in ___ by rule ___ on ___.

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 里的多个 Excel 合并成一个，加一列来源文件名。
prompt.en: Merge the Excel files in ___ into one with a source column.

prompt.zh: 每天 ___ 把 ___ 目录备份到 ___，保留最近 ___ 份。
prompt.en: Back up ___ to ___ every day at ___, keeping ___ copies.

zh: 每天「02:00」执行目录备份脚本并汇报结果
每周一「09:00」整理 inbound 中的新文件并按规则改名
每月 1 日「10:00」合并各部门上报的表格
每周五「17:00」清理下载目录中超过 30 天的临时文件（先预览）
每天「08:00」从日志中提取错误行并汇总
每季度第一天「10:00」检查常用脚本是否仍能正常运行
en: Every day at 02:00, run the backup script and report results
Every Monday at 09:00, rename new files in inbound by the agreed rule
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, merge spreadsheets from each team
Every Friday at 17:00, preview cleanup of downloads older than 30 days
Every day at 08:00, extract and summarize error lines from logs
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, check common scripts still work
